title: Quetta - Video Private Browser
summary: Fast Chromium browser with video downloads, extensions and content blocking
description:
Quetta Browser is a fast, privacy-focused Chromium browser with a built-in video downloader, powerful ad blocker, Chrome extension support, and advanced customization. Designed as a powerful Chrome alternative, Quetta gives you faster browsing, better video experiences, stronger privacy protection, and more control over your mobile web experience.

With built-in ad and tracker blocking enabled by default, Quetta removes unnecessary ads and tracking scripts to help pages load faster and provide a cleaner browsing experience. Whether you are watching videos, browsing websites, or using extensions, Quetta is built for speed, privacy, and flexibility.

⏬ Video Downloader & Media Experience
Quetta is more than a browser, it is a powerful video downloader and media browser.

· Download videos from supported websites where downloading is permitted.
· Save videos you own or are authorized to download.
· Manage supported downloads with the built-in download manager.
· Enjoy smooth video playback and convenient media controls.
· Control video experience with convenient gestures, including brightness and volume adjustments.
Availability depends on each website’s permissions and terms.

🚫 Built-in Ad Blocker & Smart Tracking Protection
Browse a cleaner and faster internet with Quetta’s built-in protection tools.

· Ad blocker enabled by default blocks intrusive ads and pop-ups.
· Tracker protection reduces unwanted online tracking.
· Smart anti-tracking technology helps protect your browsing privacy.
· Fingerprint protection helps prevent websites from identifying your device.
· Private browsing tools keep your online activity more secure.

🧩 Chrome Extension Support on Mobile
Bring your favorite browser tools to mobile.

· Supports Chrome Web Store and Edge Add-ons extensions.
· Install and manage extensions directly inside Quetta.
· Easily migrate from desktop Chrome extension workflows.
· Use productivity, privacy, media, and customization extensions.

Quetta provides a familiar Chromium-based experience while giving mobile users more flexibility and control.

⚡ Fast Chromium Browser Built for Power Users
Built on Chromium, Quetta delivers fast loading speed, smooth navigation, and reliable compatibility with modern websites.

Features include:
· Developer-friendly browsing experience.
· DevTools support for advanced users and developers.
· Efficient page loading with built-in optimization.
· Clean and simple interface without unnecessary clutter.

🎨 Highly Customizable Browsing Experience
Make Quetta work the way you want.

Customize:
· Address bar position.
· Toolbar layout.
· Tab management.
· Automatic tab closing settings.
· Browser behavior and shortcuts.

🔒 Strong Privacy Protection
Your privacy is built into the browsing experience.

Quetta provides:
· Smart tracking prevention.
· Fingerprint protection.
· Privacy mode.
· Secure browsing controls.
· Data management tools.

🌎 Global Browser Experience
Designed for users worldwide.

· Multi-language support.
· Google account login and synchronization.
· Seamless browsing experience across your devices.
· Simple and modern interface.

Why choose Quetta Browser?
Quetta combines everything you need in one powerful mobile browser: video downloading, ad blocking, Chrome extension support, privacy protection, fast Chromium performance, and deep customization.

If you want a browser that gives you more control than traditional browsers, Quetta is your smarter choice.
